correctness.rationale: The Sturm oscillation nodal theorem and reflection symmetry make the first nonconstant eigenfunction odd. Its half-interval Dirichlet-at-zero energy Rayleigh quotient has q-independent numerator and monotonically decreasing weighted mass, hence μ strictly increases. x=tanh y transforms the same quotient so 4μ/(1+q²) equals inf ||g' ||² /∫g²/(sinh²(y)+(1+q²)^(-1))dy; the denominator strictly increases in q and forces strict decrease. At q=0, Legendre P1=x has μ=1/2, and derivative of the generalized weight contributes 3/10. Hardy ∫g'²>=1/4∫g²/y² implies normalized gap≥1/16; cutoffs of y^{1/2+ε}, taking q→∞ before ε→0, prove sharpness. The independent odd-mode Galerkin implementation verified nine q values and both monotonic directions; no finite sample is used to prove the limit.
